info.name: Club Event & Workshop Management API
info.description:
All 70 endpoints of the Club Event & Workshop Management System.

1. Start the server (`npm run dev`) and run `npm run seed` once.
2. Run the folders in order (or use Collection Runner). Tokens and IDs are saved automatically into collection variables.

Full reference: API_DOCUMENTATION.md

item.name: 01 - Auth
item.description: Login as admin, register two students and log them in. Tokens are saved automatically.

item.name: 02 - Users
item.description: Profile update and admin user management.

item.name: 07 - Events
item.description: Student proposes an event (PENDING) and admin approves it. Event dates are set to next week automatically.

body.raw:
